name: Glamoured Studded Leather

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: +1 AC; a Bonus Action makes it look like ordinary clothing or another outfit.
text: While wearing this armor, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class. You can also take a Bonus Action to make the armor assume the appearance of a normal set of clothing or some other kind of armor; you decide what it looks like. It retains its normal bulk and weight, and the illusion lasts until you use this property again or doff it.
